remarks: Welcome to this exceptional townhome in one of Stamford most sought-after communities, The Manor. This one-of-a-kind 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath residence showcases refined, high-end finishes throughout. Designed for modern living, the home features a seamless open-concept layout, central air conditioning and heating, premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and recessed lighting. The spacious primary is complete with a generous walk-in closet and deck overlooking a landscaped courtyard and pool.  Situated just moments from downtown, dining, shopping, parks, public transportation, and I-95. Walking distance to local houses of worship.
